name: Flame's Blessing
description: Gain fire resistance based on your ranks in Tumble.

name: Wind Stride
description: Gain a +10-foot enhancement bonus to your land speed until the end of your current turn.

name: Blistering Flourish
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, foes within 30 feet are dazzled for 1 minute (Fortitude negates).

name: Burning Blade
description: Your melee attacks deal an extra 1d6 fire damage + 1 point per initiator level until the end of your turn.

name: Fire Riposte
description: When damaged by a melee or natural attack, counterattack with a touch attack dealing 4d6 fire damage.

name: Dragon's Flame
description: Unleash a 30-foot cone of fire dealing 6d6 fire damage (Reflex half).

name: Salamander Charge
description: Charge an opponent and leave a wall of fire in every square you move through.

name: Inferno Blast
description: Unleash an explosion of fire in a 60-foot burst centered on you, dealing 100 points of fire damage (Reflex half).

name: Iron Guard's Glare
description: Foes you threaten take a -4 penalty on attack rolls against your allies.

name: Martial Spirit
description: Whenever you hit an opponent in melee, you or an ally within 30 feet heals 2 hit points.

name: Crusader's Strike
description: Make a melee attack against an opponent of different alignment; if it hits, you or an ally within 10 feet heals 1d6 + initiator level (max +5) hp.

name: Shield Block
description: Grant an adjacent ally a bonus to AC equal to your shield bonus + 4 against one attack.

name: Thicket of Blades
description: Any opponent you threaten who takes a 5-foot step provokes an attack of opportunity from you.

name: Revitalizing Strike
description: Successful melee attack heals you or an ally within 10 feet for 3d6 + initiator level (max +10) hp.

name: Divine Surge
description: Make a single melee attack dealing an extra 8d8 points of damage.

name: Rallying Strike
description: Successful melee attack heals you and all allies within 30 feet for 3d6 + initiator level (max +15) hp.

name: Strike of Righteous Vitality
description: Successful melee attack bestows the benefit of a heal spell on you or an ally within 10 feet.

name: Stance of Clarity
description: Designate a single melee opponent; gain a +2 insight bonus to AC against that foe, and take a -2 penalty to AC against all others.

name: Moment of Perfect Mind
description: Make a Concentration check in place of a Will save.

name: Sapphire Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against target's AC; if successful, target is flat-footed and you deal +1d6 damage.

name: Action Before Thought
description: Make a Concentration check in place of a Reflex save.

name: Emerald Razor
description: Make a single melee attack as a touch attack.

name: Mind Over Body
description: Make a Concentration check in place of a Fortitude save.

name: Pearl of Black Doubt
description: Each time an opponent misses you with a melee attack, gain a cumulative +2 dodge bonus to AC until the start of your next turn.

name: Ruby Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against target's AC; if successful, you deal double normal damage.

name: Diamond Nightmare Blade
description: Make a Concentration check against target's AC; if successful, you deal quadruple normal damage.

name: Time Stands Still
description: Make two full attack actions at your full base attack bonus.

name: Punishing Stance
description: Deal an extra 1d6 points of damage on melee attacks, but take a -2 penalty to AC.

name: Steely Strike
description: Gain a +4 bonus on one melee attack; other enemies gain a +4 bonus on attack rolls against you for 1 round.

name: Steel Wind
description: Make a melee attack against two different opponents you threaten.

name: Disarming Strike
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, make a free disarm attempt that does not provoke attacks of opportunity.

name: Wall of Blades
description: Make a melee attack roll in place of your Armor Class against one incoming melee or ranged attack.

name: Iron Heart Surge
description: End one harmful spell, effect, or condition currently affecting you and gain a +2 morale bonus on attack rolls until the end of your next turn.

name: Lightning Recovery
description: Reroll a missed melee attack roll with a +2 bonus.

name: Iron Heart Focus
description: Reroll a saving throw you just failed.

name: Supreme Blade Parry
description: Gain damage reduction 5/- against all weapon attacks while you maintain this stance.

name: Strike of Perfect Clarity
description: Make a single melee attack dealing an extra 100 points of damage on a hit.

name: Step of the Wind
description: Ignore movement penalties for difficult terrain; gain +2 on attack rolls and +4 dodge bonus to AC against foes in difficult terrain.

name: Mighty Throw
description: Make a trip attack without provoking attacks of opportunity; if successful, throw the foe up to 10 feet away.

name: Counter Charge
description: Oppose a charging opponent with an opposed Strength or Dexterity check; if successful, redirect their charge path.

name: Baffling Defense
description: Make a Sense Motive check in place of your Armor Class against one incoming melee attack.

name: Clever Positioning
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, target must make a Reflex save or swap spaces with you.

name: Giant Killing Style
description: Gain a +2 bonus on attack rolls and +4 bonus on damage rolls against opponents larger than you.

name: Tornado Throw
description: Move up to triple your speed; for every 10 feet moved, you can trip and throw a foe, dealing damage based on distance.

name: Child of Shadow
description: If you move at least 10 feet during your turn, you gain concealment (20% miss chance) until the start of your next turn.

name: Island of Blades
description: You and an adjacent ally flank any opponent you both threaten, regardless of positioning.

name: Clinging Shadow Strike
description: Melee attack deals an extra 1d6 damage, and target takes a 20% miss chance on all attacks for 1 round (Fortitude negates).

name: Shadow Blade Technique
description: Roll two d20s on attack; select higher for normal damage, or lower for an extra 1d6 cold damage.

name: Shadow Jaunt
description: Teleport up to 50 feet to any unoccupied square you have line of sight and line of effect to.

name: Cloak of Deception
description: Turn greater invisible until the end of your current turn.

name: Assassin's Stance
description: Gain sneak attack +2d6 (or increase existing sneak attack by +2d6).

name: Shadow Stride
description: Teleport up to 50 feet as a move action.

name: Five-Shadow Creeping Ice Enervation Strike
description: Melee attack deals +15d6 damage and inflicts ability damage and speed penalties.

name: Stonefoot Stance
description: Gain a +2 bonus on Strength checks and +2 dodge bonus to AC against larger opponents while on the ground.

name: Charging Minotaur
description: Charging bull rush does not provoke attacks of opportunity and deals 2d6 + Strength modifier damage.

name: Stone Bones
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, gain damage reduction 5/adamantine until the start of your next turn.

name: Mountain Hammer
description: Make a melee attack dealing an extra 2d6 points of damage and overcoming all damage reduction and hardness.

name: Roots of the Mountain
description: Gain a +2 bonus to AC, +10 bonus against bull rush/trip/overrun, and foes cannot tumble past you while on the ground.

name: Bonesplitting Strike
description: Make a melee attack dealing 2 points of Constitution damage on a hit.

name: Elder Mountain Hammer
description: Make a melee attack dealing an extra 6d6 points of damage and overcoming all damage reduction and hardness.

name: Immortal Mountain Stance
description: Gain damage reduction 10/- while on the ground.

name: Mountain Tombstone Strike
description: Make a melee attack dealing 2d6 points of Constitution damage on a hit.

name: Blood in the Water
description: Gain a cumulative +1 bonus on attack and damage rolls whenever you confirm a critical hit.

name: Hunter's Sense
description: Gain the scent special ability while maintaining this stance.

name: Wolf Fang Strike
description: Attack with two weapons against a single opponent with a -2 penalty on each attack roll.

name: Sudden Leap
description: Make a Jump check to move up to the distance jumped as a swift action.

name: Claw at the Moon
description: Make a Jump check against target's AC; if successful, deal an extra 2d6 points of damage.

name: Rabid Wolf Strike
description: Gain a +4 bonus on one attack roll and deal an extra 2d6 points of damage, but take a -4 penalty to AC for 1 round.

name: Soaring Raptor Strike
description: Attack a larger foe with a +4 bonus and deal an extra 6d6 points of damage.

name: Death From Above
description: Make a DC 20 Jump check to treat the target as flat-footed and deal an extra 4d6 points of damage.

name: Feral Death Blow
description: Make a Jump check against target's AC; if successful, target must make a Fortitude save (DC 19 + Str) or die, and you deal an extra 20d6 damage.

name: Bolstering Voice
description: Allies within 60 feet gain a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, or +4 against fear effects.

name: Leading the Charge
description: Allies within 60 feet deal bonus damage on charge attacks equal to your initiator level.

name: Douse the Flames
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, the target cannot make attacks of opportunity for 1 round.

name: Leading the Attack
description: Make a melee attack; if it hits, all allies gain a +4 morale bonus on attack rolls against that target for 1 round.

name: Tactical Strike
description: Make a melee attack dealing an extra 2d6 points of damage; all adjacent allies can immediately make a 5-foot step.

name: Battle Leader's Charge
description: Make a charge attack that does not provoke attacks of opportunity and deals an extra 10 points of damage.

name: White Raven Tactics
description: Target ally within 10 feet acts on your initiative count minus 1.

name: Lions Roar
description: Upon reducing an opponent to 0 hp or less, grant all allies within 60 feet a +5 morale bonus on damage rolls for 1 round.

name: War Master's Charge
description: You and all allies within 30 feet charge target; you deal +50 damage, allies deal +25 damage, and target is stunned.
